name: sdd-slides
description: OpenSpec y Spec Kit en la práctica — dos charlas
author: Miguel Martín

scripts.build:openspec: vite build --mode openspec && node scripts/check-offline.mjs dist-openspec decks/openspec
scripts.build:spec-kit: vite build --mode spec-kit && node scripts/check-offline.mjs dist-spec-kit decks/spec-kit
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p . && npm run build:openspec && npm run build:spec-kit && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs
scripts.verify:openspec: node scripts/make-source.mjs && node scripts/verify.mjs dist-openspec artifacts/verify-openspec --source=artifacts/fuentes.md
scripts.verify:spec-kit: node scripts/make-source.mjs && node scripts/verify.mjs dist-spec-kit artifacts/verify-spec-kit --source=artifacts/fuentes.md
